category.label: Encounter Table
category.hint: Which habitat table wild Pokémon are drawn from.

chance.label: Encounter Chance (%)
chance.hint: Chance to trigger a wild Pokémon on each qualifying step.

minLevel.label: Minimum Level
minLevel.hint: Lowest level a wild Pokémon can be (unless the row overrides it).

maxLevel.label: Maximum Level
maxLevel.hint: Highest level a wild Pokémon can be (unless the row overrides it).

onEveryStep.label: Trigger On Every Step
onEveryStep.hint: Roll while moving through the region, not only on entry.

useDefaultTable.label: Use Default Table
useDefaultTable.hint: Use the built-in table for the chosen category instead of a custom one.

announceOnly.label: Announce Only
announceOnly.hint: Post a chat card instead of also spawning a wild token.

zoneName.label: Zone Name
zoneName.hint: Name announced when a trainer enters this region.

announce.label: Announce Entry
announce.hint: Post a chat message when a trainer enters.

destX.label: Destination X (px)
destX.hint: Same-scene warp target. Leave 0 to disable.

destY.label: Destination Y (px)
destY.hint: Same-scene warp target. Leave 0 to disable.

destinationScene.label: Destination Scene
destinationScene.hint: Scene to view on entry (GM side).
